cards.name: 卡片揭角 (Card Corner Peel)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 做一张可揭角的卡片，右下角按住后随拖动卷起，用折线裁切正面并露出背面，折片带柔和明暗。松手沿原路回落，短距离拖动只露一角，整张卡片保持稳定。
cards.canonical_prompt: Drag the card's lower-right corner to peel a clipped front layer, reveal the back, then spring back along the inverse path unless committed.
cards.state_machine: idle -> press -> drag -> partial_peel -> release -> spring_settle
cards.web_implementation: Motion drag progress with CSS clip-path polygon and @nocoo/basalt tokens.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with Canvas/path clipping, native SwiftUI Spring(response:dampingRatio:), and Reduce Motion crossfade.
cards.token_guardrails: CLS = 0; tabular-nums where values appear; >=4.5:1 contrast; 44x44pt hit target; Reduce Motion fallback.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI `.onContinuousHover` for corner curl preview plus pointer `DragGesture` driving a custom `Shape` or `Canvas` clip path and `.visualEffect` / Metal `ShaderLibrary` crease shading; settles with native `Animation.spring(duration: 0.38, bounce: 0.15)` while keeping the outer card frame locked inside its `NSWindow` or `NSPopover` grid.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)` on a 44x44pt lower-right corner hit region, clipping the front card layer via a dynamic `Path`/`Canvas` fold line and revealing the back layer; uses `Animation.spring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.78)` on release and `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .soft), trigger: isCommitted)`.
cards.native_guardrails: Zero layout shift (card bounds never jump); `.monospacedDigit()` on any revealed numeric metrics; >=4.5:1 foreground/background contrast in Light and Dark mode using semantic `Color.primary` / `Color(nsColor: .controlBackgroundColor)` / `Color(uiColor: .secondarySystemGroupedBackground)`; >=44x44pt corner hit target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces peel geometry with a direct `.opacity` crossfade; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` replaces translucent back-card layers with opaque system surfaces.

cards.name: 滑动确认 (Slide-to-Confirm)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 做一个滑动确认按钮，圆钮与轨道填充跟随同一拖动进度。未到终点松手，阻尼回到起点且不执行；到终点松手才确认，箭头变成对勾，文字变为已完成。
cards.canonical_prompt: Keep thumb and track fill on one normalized drag progress; cancel below the endpoint with damped return, commit only at endpoint, then swap arrow to checkmark and copy.
cards.web_implementation: Motion drag controls thumb and track; CSS/SVG icon morph; Basalt semantic success tokens.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with native SwiftUI Spring(response:dampingRatio:), contentTransition(.symbolEffect), SensoryFeedback, and numericText.
cards.token_guardrails: No accidental commit; 44x44pt target; explicit threshold; >=4.5:1 contrast; Reduce Motion opacity/state fallback.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI pointer `DragGesture` (plus keyboard `Return` / `⌘Return` confirmation equivalent) binding a single normalized progress `CGFloat` (`0.0...1.0`) to both the thumb offset and track fill width; commits only when released at `progress >= 0.95`, morphing SF Symbols (`arrow.right` to `checkmark`) via `.contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))` and settling with `Animation.spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.1)`.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `DragGesture` on a 44x44pt thumb inside a capsule track (`GlassEffectContainer` / `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)` where appropriate), driving thumb position and tint fill from one shared progress state; damped return via `Animation.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.82)` if released early, or commit at endpoint with `.contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))`, `.contentTransition(.numericText())`, and `.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: isConfirmed)`.
cards.native_guardrails: No accidental commit below threshold; >=44x44pt thumb hit target on iOS and >=32x32pt on macOS with full keyboard accessibility (`accessibilityAction`); >=4.5:1 text and icon contrast against both unfilled and filled semantic `Color.green` / `Color.accentColor` tracks in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` disables spring oscillation and uses instant state/opacity transition; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` backs the track with solid `Color(uiColor: .tertiarySystemFill)`.

cards.name: 拉绳开关 (Pull-Cord Light Switch)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 做一个拉绳灯光开关，绳头跟随竖向拖动，超过触发距离时切换灯光与玻璃暖光，每次拉动切换一次。松手收回绳子，摆幅逐渐衰减，再拉一次可以关闭。
cards.canonical_prompt: Track vertical cord drag; cross the trigger distance once to toggle light and warm glass glow, then return with damped swing and allow the next pull to turn it off.
cards.state_machine: off_idle -> pull -> threshold -> on_commit -> return_swing -> on_idle -> pull -> off_commit -> settle
cards.web_implementation: Motion drag transform with Anime.js damped return and tokenized warm-glow CSS.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture plus KeyframeAnimator/native SwiftUI Spring, ShaderLibrary glow, and SensoryFeedback.
cards.token_guardrails: One toggle per pull; bounded drag; no glare-only status; 44x44pt target; Reduce Motion removes swing.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI vertical pointer `DragGesture` on the cord handle with direct click/keyboard (`Space`) toggle support; crossing the vertical threshold toggles state once per pull, drives warm illumination via native `Canvas` / `.shadow` / `NSGlassEffectView` tinting, and animates the cord's damped pendulum return using `KeyframeAnimator` with `SpringKeyframe`.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI vertical `DragGesture` on a >=44x44pt cord handle target; crossing the trigger distance fires `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .medium), trigger: isLit)`, toggles the ambient glass glow (`.glassEffect` / radial gradient overlay), and settles the cord back with `KeyframeAnimator` damped swing.
cards.native_guardrails: Strictly one toggle per pull cycle with bounded vertical drag distance; state is never communicated by glow alone (always pair with explicit SF Symbol `lightbulb.fill` / `lightbulb` and semantic label); >=44x44pt hit target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark appearances; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` eliminates pendulum swing and snaps the cord smoothly; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` uses opaque warm surface fills.

cards.name: 滑动工具栏 (Magnification Scrubbing Toolbar)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 做一条可滑选的工具栏，当前图标随手指靠近连续放大，相邻图标平滑让位，位置由实时宽度累加计算。显示当前名称，松手提交选择，画布同步切换工具效果。
cards.canonical_prompt: Scrub across a toolbar whose focused icon magnifies continuously and neighbors make room from live accumulated widths; show the name and commit the selected tool on release.
cards.state_machine: idle -> hover/drag -> focus_magnify -> neighbor_reflow -> release -> commit -> settle
cards.web_implementation: Motion layout animation with measured widths, CSS transform scale, and tokenized focus ring.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with matchedGeometryEffect, measured layout, and native SwiftUI Spring(response:dampingRatio:).
cards.token_guardrails: Live width accumulation, no overlap, single-line label, 44x44pt targets, Reduce Motion uses discrete focus.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Mac Dock-style scrubbing bar using SwiftUI `.onContinuousHover` and pointer `DragGesture` inside a `GeometryReader` / custom `Layout` that computes each icon's scale from pointer distance and accumulates live widths so neighbors reflow without overlap; displays a single-line tooltip label and commits on click/release with `Animation.interactiveSpring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.8)`.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Touch-scrubbing floating toolbar inside a `GlassEffectContainer` using `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)` and `DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)` to track finger X location, continuously scaling the focused SF Symbol icon while reflowing neighbors from live accumulated widths; emits `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: hoveredToolID)` as focus changes and commits the active tool on finger release.
cards.native_guardrails: Positions derived from live width accumulation so icons never overlap or clip; single-line non-wrapping tool label; >=44x44pt effective touch targets on iOS and >=28x28pt pointer targets on macOS with keyboard arrow-key navigation; >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces continuous magnification with discrete highlight focus; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` replaces Liquid Glass bar material with opaque system background.

cards.name: 消息气泡反馈 (Long-Press Bubble Reaction)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 长按消息后拾起当前气泡，周围消息降低亮度，三枚表情错峰展开。选中并松手后，同一表情沿弧线缩到气泡角标，菜单收回。徽标随气泡归位，再点可取消。
cards.canonical_prompt: Long-press and lift the message bubble, dim neighbors, stagger three reactions, then arc the selected reaction into the bubble badge on release; tap again cancels.
cards.state_machine: idle -> long_press -> lifted_dimmed -> reaction_menu -> select -> arc_commit/cancel -> settle
cards.web_implementation: Motion shared layout with Anime.js stagger and SVG arc path; Basalt reaction tokens.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI long press, matchedGeometryEffect, KeyframeAnimator arc, and SensoryFeedback.
cards.token_guardrails: Preserve message context; 44x44pt reactions; tabular-nums for counts; Reduce Motion uses fade/scale.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Hover action bar or secondary-click / long-press on a message bubble that dims surrounding rows via `.opacity`, presents staggered SF Symbol / emoji reaction items in a floating `.glassEffect` or `NSPopover`-style callout using `PhaseAnimator`, and arcs the chosen reaction into the bubble corner badge via `matchedGeometryEffect` and `KeyframeAnimator` (clicking the badge again removes it).
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `LongPressGesture` sequenced with `DragGesture` that lifts the target message bubble with `.scaleEffect`, dims background context, staggers three reaction pills inside a `GlassEffectContainer` (`.glassEffectID` morphing), fires `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: isMenuOpen)`, and animates the selected reaction along a `KeyframeAnimator` arc into the corner badge on release.
cards.native_guardrails: Message list scroll offset and layout stability preserved (`CLS = 0`); `.monospacedDigit()` on reaction count badges; >=44x44pt hit targets for each reaction option on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; >=4.5:1 badge contrast in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces staggered lift and arc trajectory with a direct scale/opacity transition; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` uses opaque elevated surface colors for the reaction bar and badge.

cards.name: 文件拖入文件夹 (Spring-Loaded Folder Drop)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 拖动文件靠近文件夹时，夹口张开并显示落点；悬停阶段保持原数量；松手命中后文件缩进前后盖之间，数量加一，再合上夹口；未命中则回到原位置。
cards.canonical_prompt: When a dragged file nears a folder, open the folder and show the drop target without changing count; on hit, tuck the file between covers, increment count, and close, otherwise return.
cards.state_machine: idle -> drag -> near_target -> folder_open -> hover -> commit/cancel -> settle
cards.web_implementation: Motion pointer drag with Anime.js folder lid choreography, hit testing, and numeric transition.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture/drop delegate, matchedGeometryEffect tuck, numericText count, and SensoryFeedback.
cards.token_guardrails: Visible target and hit parity; count changes only on commit; 44x44pt targets; Reduce Motion crossfade.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI `.draggable` / `.dropDestination` (or spatial `DragGesture` with `DropDelegate`) on macOS where hovering near a folder opens the front/back folder layers using `Animation.spring(duration: 0.28)` and highlights the drop ring without mutating the item count; releasing inside the target tucks the item between folder covers via `matchedGeometryEffect`, increments the `.monospacedDigit()` badge with `.contentTransition(.numericText())`, and closes the folder.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `DragGesture` / `.dropDestination` with proximity detection that opens the folder icon layers and triggers `.sensoryFeedback(.alignment, trigger: isHoveringFolder)`; dropping on target tucks the file card into the folder via `matchedGeometryEffect`, updates the count badge with `.contentTransition(.numericText())` and `.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: dropCommitted)`, or springs back to origin if cancelled.
cards.native_guardrails: Visual drop target boundary matches hit-test geometry 1:1; folder item count mutates strictly on commit (never during hover); `.monospacedDigit()` on count readouts; >=44x44pt drop target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces folder-lid 3D/spring choreography with a highlight border and crossfade.

cards.name: 图表联动筛选 (Chart Cross-Filtering)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 点图表里的分类，下方列表和统计数字跟着变，再点一下全部恢复。
cards.canonical_prompt: Click a chart category/segment to highlight it and cross-filter the list and summary metrics below; click the same category again to reset to all items.
cards.web_implementation: Derive list and KPIs from a shared activeCategory state; highlight active Recharts/Basalt segment, dim unselected segments, and toggle off on repeat click.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI Charts selection binding filtering the shared query state with .contentTransition(.numericText()) on summary readouts and tap-to-deselect.
cards.token_guardrails: tabular-nums / monospacedDigit for changing metrics; preserve active search keyword and sort order; >=4.5:1 active/inactive contrast.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Swift Charts `Chart` with `.chartAngleSelection(value:)` or `.chartXSelection(value:)` (plus direct pointer click/hover on marks) bound to an `@Observable` view model's `selectedCategory` property; selecting a mark highlights the active series, dims unselected marks via `.opacity(0.3)`, and synchronously filters the macOS `Table` / `List` and summary KPI cards (`.contentTransition(.numericText())`); clicking the same category or pressing `Esc` resets to all items.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Swift Charts interactive selection binding (`.chartXSelection` / `.chartAngleSelection`) on a touch-friendly chart mark (>=44x44pt effective selection zone) with `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selectedCategory)`; updates the shared `@Observable` filter state to cross-filter the `List` / `LazyVStack` and animate summary metrics via `.contentTransition(.numericText())` with tap-again-to-reset.
cards.native_guardrails: All changing KPI numbers use `.monospacedDigit()` so layout never shifts; cross-filtering preserves any active search text and sort descriptor; active vs. dimmed chart marks and text maintain >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes using distinct Swift Charts foreground style scales separate from semantic status colors; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` disables animated chart bar/sector morphing.

cards.name: 组合筛选与排序 (Combined Filter & Orthogonal Sort)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 选好类别搜关键词，还能按数量升降序排，而且排序不会清空之前的筛选条件。
cards.canonical_prompt: Compose category filter, keyword search, and ascending/descending sort orthogonally; toggling sort order reorders the filtered subset without clearing active filters.
cards.web_implementation: Pure derived selector: filter(items, category, keyword) then sort(field, dir); keep filter and sort controls in independent state slices.
cards.mobile_implementation: SwiftUIsearchable + category filter tokens + Menu/Picker sort descriptor operating on the filtered collection without resetting filter state.
cards.token_guardrails: Sorting never clears filter/search state; provide clear active indicators and reset options.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI `.searchable` field in the window/split-view toolbar, horizontal category filter tokens/segmented `Picker`, and `Table` column `SortComparator` (or toolbar sort `Menu`) backed by independent properties on an `@Observable` state model; a pure derived computed array applies category + keyword filtering first and sorts the resulting slice without ever clearing active filter state.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Navigation-integrated `.searchable` bar, horizontal scrolling category filter capsules (`>=44pt` touch height), and a trailing toolbar `Menu` / `Picker` for ascending/descending `SortDescriptor` operating orthogonally on the filtered collection with `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: sortOrder)` and animated list reordering.
cards.native_guardrails: Changing sort field or direction never resets active search text or category filters; active filter count and sort direction remain visibly indicated with >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes; hit targets >=44x44pt on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` disables row reordering animations.

cards.name: 列表联动详情 (In-Place Master-Detail Linkage)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 点左侧记录，右侧详情直接更新，不用跳页面，列表顺序也不变。
cards.canonical_prompt: Select a record in the master list to update the detail pane in-place without page navigation, preserving the master list's sort order, filters, and scroll position.
cards.web_implementation: Two-column master-detail layout with selectedId state; render detail panel in-place and keep master list key/scroll stable.
cards.mobile_implementation: NavigationSplitView on iPad/macOS or in-place detail card/sheet on compact screens, preserving list scroll and ordering.
cards.token_guardrails: CLS = 0 on selection; master list order and scroll offset remain unchanged; clear selected row state.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Two- or three-column `NavigationSplitView` (or trailing `.inspector(isPresented:)`) where `List(selection: $selectedItemID)` updates the detail pane in-place on pointer click or up/down arrow keys without mutating the master list's sort order, active filters, or `ScrollView` offset.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Adaptive `NavigationSplitView` on regular horizontal size class (`horizontalSizeClass == .regular` on iPad / landscape) and in-place detail card or `.sheet(item: $selectedItem)` / `NavigationStack` on compact iPhone screens, preserving the master `List` scroll position, filter state, and row ordering across selection changes.
cards.native_guardrails: Zero layout jump (`CLS = 0`) and preserved scroll offset in the master list when selecting or switching records; selected row uses native system selection highlight with >=4.5:1 text contrast in Light and Dark modes; >=44pt minimum row height on iOS and >=28pt on macOS; respects `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` and `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)`.

cards.name: 无结果与局部恢复 (Scoped Empty State & Context-Preserving Recovery)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 搜不到时显示空状态，清空关键词后数据恢复，其他筛选条件还得保留。
cards.canonical_prompt: Show a contextual empty state when keyword search yields zero matches; clearing the keyword restores matching data while keeping other active filters intact.
cards.web_implementation: Empty state names the active query/filter and offers a 'Clear keyword' action that resets only searchQuery while preserving category and sort state.
cards.mobile_implementation: ContentUnavailableView.search(text:) or contextual empty state whose reset action clears search text without wiping selected category pills.
cards.token_guardrails: Empty state explains why and provides a 1-click partial recovery CTA; non-keyword filters remain preserved.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: In-place `ContentUnavailableView` inside the filtered results pane naming the unmatched `searchQuery` while showing active category filter badges; provides a prominent `Button("Clear Search Keyword")` (plus `Esc` shortcut) that resets `searchQuery = ""` while keeping selected category filters and sort order intact.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Native `ContentUnavailableView` (customizing `ContentUnavailableView.search(text:)` with an explicit `actions` closure) containing a >=44pt-tall recovery button that clears only `searchQuery` with `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: searchQuery.isEmpty)` while preserving active category filter pills and sort state.
cards.native_guardrails: Empty state explicitly states which keyword produced zero results and offers a single-action partial recovery that never wipes non-keyword filters; >=4.5:1 contrast on empty-state iconography, title, description, and CTA button in Light and Dark modes; >=44x44pt CTA target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS.

cards.name: 状态联动汇总 (Live Status-to-Summary Aggregation)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 卡片状态一变，下方的分类数量和颜色也得跟着同步更新。
cards.canonical_prompt: When an item's status changes, synchronously recompute summary category counts, ratios, and semantic status colors from the same single source of truth.
cards.web_implementation: Derive summary badges, counts, and semantic color tokens directly from the items array rather than separate static counters.
cards.mobile_implementation: Computed properties on @Observable / SwiftData model collections driving summary badges and semantic tokens with .numericText() transition.
cards.token_guardrails: Single source of truth for item status and summary counters; semantic tokens calibrated for both Light and Dark mode.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Single `@Observable` model or SwiftData `@Query` collection where summary category counts, ratios, and semantic status colors (`Color.green`, `Color.orange`, `Color.red`, `Color.secondary`) are computed properties derived directly from item statuses; mutating a row's status immediately updates top/bottom summary cards with `.monospacedDigit()` and `.contentTransition(.numericText())`.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Reactive `@Observable` / SwiftData collection driving both individual item cards and summary status badges from a single source of truth; toggling an item's status triggers `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: statusChangeCounter)` and animates summary counters in-place via `.monospacedDigit()` and `.contentTransition(.numericText())`.
cards.native_guardrails: Strict single source of truth (never maintain separate manual counters that can drift from item array state); `.monospacedDigit()` on all summary numbers and percentages; semantic status colors calibrated for >=4.5:1 contrast in both Light and Dark appearances and paired with SF Symbols or text labels (never color alone); `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces rolling numeric transitions with instant updates.

cards.name: 暗黑高能竞技荧光色板 (Kinetic Obsidian & Volt Telemetry Palette)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 高对比暗黑竞技色板（灵感源自 Spotify / Nike Run Club / Hevy）：深曜石底色 #0B0D10、分层卡片 #14181F、高能荧光绿主色 #C8FF00（或电光橙）、热身琥珀色 #F59E0B、递减紫 #A855F7，保障健身房强光与暗光下 >=7:1 极高可读性。
cards.canonical_prompt: High-contrast obsidian dark athletic palette (#0B0D10 base, #14181F elevated surface, #C8FF00 volt accent, semantic warmup/drop-set badges) with >=7:1 metric legibility.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Asset Catalog adaptive Color Set with dark-biased `NSAppearance`, semantic `Color.primary` white text, and `AppTheme.accent` volt highlight restricted to active selection and primary CTAs.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI adaptive Asset Catalog colors (`surfacePrimary`, `surfaceCard`, `accentVolt`) paired with `.preferredColorScheme(.dark)` option and high-contrast `.glassProminent` primary action.
cards.native_guardrails: >=4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast on filled volt buttons (use dark #0B0D10 ink on #C8FF00 fill, never white text on lime); semantic status colors remain fixed.

cards.name: 温润瑞士纸感与深林墨色账本色板 (Warm Editorial Paper & Forest Ledger)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 温润纸感金融与阅读色板（灵感源自 Apple Wallet / Wise / Readwise）：浅色模式采用暖象牙纸底 #FAF7F2 与纯白浮卡 #FFFFFF，深色模式采用深炭墨 #121316 与 #1C1E22；主强调色为深林绿 #0F5132（暗色 #34D399）配黄铜金点缀 #D97706。
cards.canonical_prompt: Warm ivory editorial paper surface (#FAF7F2 light / #121316 dark) paired with deep forest ink (#0F5132 / #34D399) and brass accents for calm financial and reading workspaces.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: macOS `NSWindow` background tinted with subtle warm paper luminance tiers (L0 `#FAF7F2` -> L1 `#FFFFFF` card) in Light mode and carbon slate in Dark mode.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI semantic surface tokens in `AppTheme.swift` with `Color(uiColor: .systemGroupedBackground)` fallback and high-contrast tabular currency coloring.
cards.native_guardrails: Never hardcode raw RGB without Light/Dark pair; keep semantic income/expense colors distinct and accessible for red-green color blindness (pair with +/- prefix).

cards.name: 深空声波青与录音珊瑚极客色板 (Precision Acoustic Slate & Sonic Cyan)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 精密声学与 AI 工具色板（灵感源自 Flighty / Linear / Overcast）：深岩灰底色 #0E1117、声波青 #38BDF8 代表 AI 转写与就绪态、录音珊瑚红 #F43F5E 代表麦克风激活态、翡翠绿 #10B981 代表任务完成。
cards.canonical_prompt: Precision acoustic dark slate (#0E1117) with sonic cyan (#38BDF8) for AI processing and recording coral (#F43F5E) for active voice capture.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: macOS `MenuBarExtra` / `NSPopover` dark vibrancy chrome with subtle cyan `.glassEffect(.regular.tint(.cyan.opacity(0.16)))` during AI refinement.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: iOS single-hand capture surface with high-visibility coral recording state and cyan AI Todo extraction pill.

cards.name: 暖阳奶油与多巴胺贴纸生活色板 (Sunlit Cream & Tactile Sticker Palette)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 温暖生活与语言学习贴纸色板（灵感源自 CapWords / Duolingo / Airbnb）：日光奶油底色 #FFFDF9、珊瑚粉 #FF5A5F、钴蓝 #2563EB、明黄 #FACC15，搭配柔和深褐正文 #1F2937（避免生硬纯黑）。
cards.canonical_prompt: Sunlit cream canvas (#FFFDF9) with warm charcoal ink (#1F2937) and joyful coral/cobalt/sunflower category accents.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Soft neutral canvas with saturated category tag pills (`color.opacity(0.15)` fill + full-saturation label).
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Tactile cards with subtle bottom lip border and adaptive dark-mode desaturation so playful colors never vibrate on OLED dark backgrounds.
cards.native_guardrails: Desaturate pastel/neon accents by 15-20% in Dark Mode to prevent halation; verify >=4.5:1 contrast on all pill labels.

cards.name: 高能运动仪表盘风格母体 (Kinetic Athletic Telemetry Archetype)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 高能运动记录风格配方（源自 awesome-ios-design-md 的 Hevy / Strong / Nike Run Club）：零多余装饰边框，采用大字重 SF Pro Rounded 数值展示、紧凑表格行或全屏焦点大卡、5x4 定制网格键盘，配合干脆的触觉反馈。
cards.canonical_prompt: High-energy athletic logging archetype: borderless luminance-tiered surfaces, oversized SF Pro Rounded tabular numerals, zero decorative chrome, and instant tactile confirmation.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Dense telemetry grid with 4pt spacing scale (`AppTheme.Space`), `.monospacedDigit()` columns, and `SWActivityHeatmap` / `SWRingChart` summary widgets.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Dual-mode architecture (Tiled Table vs Focus Card) with `ConcentricRectangle` outer containers, 44x44pt independent check hit targets, and `AppPressableButtonStyle` (`scaleEffect(0.97)`).
cards.native_guardrails: Ban Web-style 1px gray borders (`Tell #9 Wireframe Borders`) and nested cards (`Tell #7 Everything is a Card`); keep Liquid Glass strictly on top switcher and floating rest bar.

cards.name: 瑞士网格与人文账本风格母体 (Swiss Editorial & Tactile Wallet Archetype)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 瑞士社论与质感卡包风格配方（源自 awesome-ios-design-md 的 Apple Wallet / Wise / Cash App）：New York 衬线大标题或高对比无衬线净值大字，列表采用干净的原生分组与微細分割线，账户卡支持叠卡展开（ShipSwift SWWallet）。
cards.canonical_prompt: Swiss editorial ledger archetype combining serif/sans typographic contrast, clean hairline list hierarchy, and tactile stacked wallet cards (`SWWallet`).
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Two-column `NavigationSplitView` with `.unifiedCompact` toolbar, `Table` / `List` hairline rows, and `SWAreaChart` + `SWDonutChart` net-worth breakdown.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Native `List` / `Section` hierarchy (no card-in-card), hero net-worth header with `.contentTransition(.numericText())`, and `ShipSwift` `SWWallet` card stack.
cards.native_guardrails: Never use heavy drop shadows (`Tell #8 Shadowboxing`); rely on 3 luminance tiers (L0 canvas < L1 section < L2 focal card) and typographic scale.

cards.name: 精密仪器与极客桌面工作台母体 (Precision Cockpit & Developer Workbench)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 精密航空仪表与极客工具风格（源自 Flighty / Linear / BAMA mac-design）：入口优先（全局快捷键唤起浮动面板 + 菜单栏常驻）、4pt 严格网格对齐、乐观 UI（回车即刻落盘无阻断转圈）、高信息密度胶囊徽章。
cards.canonical_prompt: Precision instrument and Mac/iOS pro-tool archetype: entry-points-first (`MenuBarExtra` / hotkey panel), strict 4pt grid alignment, optimistic UI, and monospace telemetry.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: BAMA `mac-design` rules: 380pt `NSPopover` or multi-pane `NavigationSplitView`, `28x28pt` compact controls, `13pt` body / `11pt` mono badges, `.onHover` + `.pointerStyle`, paired with `SWThinkingIndicator` and `SWKPICard`.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Compact single-hand capture bar in bottom thumb zone, instant clipboard/iCloud handoff banner, and live status pills.
cards.native_guardrails: Zero decorative bounce on 100+/day actions (`dampingRatio: 1.0`); never use iOS `.hoverEffect` on macOS (`@available(macOS, unavailable)`).

cards.name: 拟物贴纸与微庆典生活风格母体 (Playful Tactile Sticker & Game-Feel Archetype)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 实物贴纸与多感官微庆典风格（源自 CapWords / Duolingo / claude-code-apple-skills game-feel）：卡片带真实白边或微立体按压唇边，达成里程碑时协同触发 Haptics + 粒子/全息闪卡（ShipSwift SWFoil / SWConfetti / SWParticleTransition）。
cards.canonical_prompt: Tactile sticker and game-feel celebration archetype: die-cut sticker borders, responsive spring press (`0.94` scale), and synchronized Haptics + Metal foil/confetti milestone rewards.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Interactive canvas cards with `.visualEffect` tilt, `SWFoil` holographic shader on collectible cards, and subtle sound/motion reward on completion.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI sticker cards with `Spring(response: 0.28, dampingRatio: 0.72)`, `SWConfetti` / `SWParticleTransition` on streak milestones, and Single-Owner `.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger:)`.
cards.native_guardrails: Follow `game-feel` rarity ladder: reserve full-screen confetti/foil for rare milestones; keep everyday taps under 120ms; Single-Owner haptics (never double-fire in ViewModel and View).

cards.name: Apple 原生双层液态玻璃导航与浮动控制栏 (Liquid Glass Functional Chrome)
cards.source_prompt_zh: Apple iOS 26 / macOS 26 原生双层液态玻璃：玻璃本身是透明光学折射材质（非黑底渐变），仅用于顶栏切换器、底部浮动条与悬浮气泡（`.glassEffect(.regular.interactive())` + `GlassEffectContainer`），通透折射下方柔和的亮色/自然内容层。
cards.canonical_prompt: Enforce the Two-Layer Liquid Glass rule: wrap adjacent floating controls in `GlassEffectContainer` with `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive())` applied after layout/padding modifiers, while keeping content rows/cards on solid semantic surfaces.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: `GlassEffectContainer` in floating `NSPopover` headers or overlay HUDs; standard `.toolbar` and `NavigationSplitView` sidebar materials without custom opaque background overrides.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: `GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 12)` with `@Namespace` and `.glassEffectID` for morphing floating pills/bars; `.buttonStyle(.glass)` for secondary actions and at most one `.buttonStyle(.glassProminent)` primary CTA.
cards.native_guardrails: Always place `.glassEffect(...)` AFTER `.padding()` and `.frame()`; only attach `.interactive()` to tappable/focusable controls; never apply `.glassEffect` inside `List`/`ForEach` content rows.

cards.name: ShipSwift + Genjutsu Metal 着色器玻璃与流体材质库 (Metal Shader Glass, Foil & Liquid Chrome)
cards.source_prompt_zh: SwiftUI Metal 光学材质着色器（`ShipSwift/SWMetal` + `genjutsu`）：重点是色差透镜折射 (`SWChromaticGlass`)、可拖拽玻璃球 (`SWGlassOrb`)、拉丝铝 (`SWPolishedAluminum`)、水波焦散 (`SWWater`) 等物理质感；底色搭配干净高明度或同色系弧线过渡，绝不掺杂脏黑底。
cards.canonical_prompt: Escalate beyond standard SwiftUI modifiers using self-contained Metal Stitchable Shaders (`.colorEffect`, `.distortionEffect`, `.layerEffect`) from `ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWAnimation/SWMetal/` and `genjutsu`.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Copy paired `.swift` + `.metal` files from `~/Development/Personal/collected-tools/repos/shipswift/ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWAnimation/SWMetal/` (e.g., `SWGrainGradient`, `SWPolishedAluminum`, `SWChromaticGlass`) for hero headers, AI active states, or badge cards.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Use `.colorEffect` / `.layerEffect(..., maxSampleOffset:)` with `TimelineView(.animation)` for 60/120fps GPU shaders (`SWGlassOrb`, `SWFoil`, `SWWater`); pause timeline when off-screen or when `accessibilityReduceMotion` is true.
cards.native_guardrails: Follow `genjutsu` escalation ladder (`Built-in modifiers -> .visualEffect -> Canvas -> Metal Shader`); gate continuous `TimelineView` shaders behind `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` and scene phase.

cards.name: ShipSwift 源码级高阶 UI 组件库直连 (SWWallet, SWKPICard, SWThinkingIndicator, SWStepper)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 当系统原生控件不足以表达高阶交互时，直接按需拣选 `ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWComponent/` 自包含源码组件并注入当前项目的 `AppTheme`：包括 Apple Wallet 叠卡卡包 (`SWWallet`)、AI 思考律动指示器 (`SWThinkingIndicator`)、指标卡 (`SWKPICard`)、胶囊搜索栏 (`SWSearchBar`)、步进器 (`SWStepper`)。
cards.canonical_prompt: Adopt self-contained SwiftUI source components from `ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWComponent/` (`SWWallet`, `SWThinkingIndicator`, `SWKPICard`, `SWStepper`, `SWStatusBadge`) restyled with the app-local `AppTheme.swift` tokens.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Copy target `.swift` file from `~/Development/Personal/collected-tools/repos/shipswift/ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWComponent/`, bind colors/radii to `AppTheme`, and add `@FocusState` / `.onHover` pointer support.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Copy target `.swift` file into product module, wire `AppTheme` semantic colors and `SensoryFeedback`, ensuring >=44x44pt hit targets and Dynamic Type scaling.
cards.native_guardrails: Never import a monolithic external UI wrapper dependency for 1-2 bespoke components; copy only the needed self-contained SwiftUI source file and adapt it to `AppTheme`.

cards.name: ShipSwift 高阶定制图表库 (SWActivityHeatmap, SWRadarChart, SWRingChart, SWNetworkGraph)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 在原生 Swift Charts（折线/柱状/面积/扇形）之外，通过 `ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWChart/` 补齐 GitHub 风格训练/贡献热力图 (`SWActivityHeatmap`)、多维能力雷达图 (`SWRadarChart`)、三环进度 (`SWRingChart`) 与 3D 节点关系网 (`SWNetworkGraph`)。
cards.canonical_prompt: Complement native Swift Charts with `ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWChart/` (`SWActivityHeatmap`, `SWRadarChart`, `SWRingChart`, `SWNetworkGraph`) using `AppTheme` semantic series colors and `.monospacedDigit()` readouts.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Embed `SWActivityHeatmap` or `SWRadarChart` inside dashboard cards with pointer hover tooltips and `AppTheme.Space` 4pt grid padding.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Pair `SWRingChart` or `SWActivityHeatmap` with touch scrubbing selection and `.contentTransition(.numericText())` summary headers.
cards.native_guardrails: Provide VoiceOver `.accessibilityLabel` and `.accessibilityValue` summaries on every chart canvas.

cards.name: ShipSwift + Emil 物理微交互与粒子转场 (SWChangeEffect, SWParticleTransition, SWConfetti, SWShimmer)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 结合 Emil Kowalski 动效频率门禁与 `ShipSwift/SWPackage/SWAnimation/`：高频操作 (>100次/天) 保持零位移临界阻尼 (`dampingRatio: 1.0`)；关键数值变更用 `SWChangeEffect` 摇晃/脉冲，加载态用 `SWShimmer` / `SWLightSweep`，删除或达成纪录用 `SWParticleTransition` / `SWConfetti`。
cards.canonical_prompt: Combine Emil Kowalski frequency gating (`100+/day` zero bounce, `dampingRatio: 1.0`) with `ShipSwift` micro-animations (`SWChangeEffect`, `SWShimmer`, `SWParticleTransition`, `SWConfetti`) and `game-feel` single-owner haptics.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Subtle `SWShimmer` loading placeholders and `SWChangeEffect` value pulses without full-window motion clutter.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Pair `SWChangeEffect` / `SWParticleTransition` with `.sensoryFeedback` (Single-Owner rule) and `.contentTransition(.numericText())`.
cards.native_guardrails: Ban waterfall entrance animations on routine screens (`Tell #14 The Grand Entrance`); fall back to instant opacity crossfade when `accessibilityReduceMotion` is enabled.

cards.name: 色轮弧线渐变铁律（Instagram 暖阳弧线，严禁穿心灰黑死区）(Hue-Arc Luminous Gradient Rule)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 渐变色绝不在取色板上走直线或直接混入纯黑 #000000（RGB 直线插值经过色轮中心会产生肮脏的灰黑死区 Muddy Dead Zone）。必须像 Instagram 图标一样沿色轮外圈走同明度/高饱和度『色相弧线』（如暖黄 #FEDA77 -> 珊瑚橙 #F58529 -> 品红 #DD2A7B -> 柔紫 #8134AF），或加入高明度奶白/柔光过渡点。
cards.canonical_prompt: Never interpolate gradients in a straight RGB line across the color wheel or fade into #000000 (which creates a muddy gray/black dead zone). Step through adjacent hues along a high-luminance arc (Instagram-style warm yellow -> coral -> rose -> violet, or sky blue -> aqua -> mint) with luminous white/pastel stops.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Use multi-stop `LinearGradient` or `MeshGradient` stepping through adjacent HSB/OKLCH hues at high brightness (`B >= 85%`), never `colors: [accent, .black]`.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI 3-to-4 stop `LinearGradient` / `MeshGradient` along a warm or cool hue arc (e.g., `[Color(hex: 0xFEDA77), Color(hex: 0xF58529), Color(hex: 0xDD2A7B)]`), keeping luminance clean behind `.glassEffect`.
cards.native_guardrails: Ban 2-stop complementary RGB gradients and `to .black` fades; always insert an intermediate adjacent hue stop to curve around the gray dead zone.

cards.name: 禅意留白与纸感清单跨界母体 (Things 3 / Bear / Notion × Fitness Tiled Plan)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 跨品类混搭母体 A（`Things 3 / Bear / Notion × Fitness 平铺版训中计划表`）：打破健身 App 只能用暗黑荧光绿的刻板印象，将 `Things 3` 的温润留白（`#FFFFFF` / `#F5F6F8`）、22pt 圆圈中心扩散打勾动画（`ThingsCheckbox` `scaleEffect(0.001 -> 1.0)` + `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .soft))`）、`Bear` 暖纸分组与柔和蓝 `#4F97FF` / 鼠尾草绿 `#57C98B` 嫁接到抗阻训练平铺计划表，让完成每组深蹲像勾选一张优雅的 GTD 清单。
cards.canonical_prompt: Cross-domain remix grafting Things 3 / Bear / Notion calm paper whitespace, center-out circular checkbox fill animations (`22pt`), and soft blue/sage semantic pills onto a tiled workout logging checklist.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: macOS `NavigationSplitView` workout planner with `Things 3` airy `#F5F6F8` grouping, `13pt` SF Pro + tabular set columns, hover row highlight (`#4F97FF` at `10%` opacity), and keyboard `Space` to check sets.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI tiled workout list with `20pt` horizontal margins, borderless luminance grouping (`#FFFFFF` canvas + `#F5F6F8` group pill), `ThingsCheckbox` center-out spring (`response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.6`), and `MagicPlusButton` floating action.
cards.native_guardrails: Zero dark-neon gym clichés or heavy 1px table grid borders; keep completed sets softly dimmed (`#8A8A8E`) rather than violently deleted so volume history stays legible.

cards.name: 呼吸感正念专注跨界母体 (Calm / Headspace / Endel × Fitness Focus & Rest)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 跨品类混搭母体 B（`Calm / Headspace / Endel × Fitness 专注版训中大卡 & 组间休息`）：将正念冥想 App 的呼吸节律圆环（`BreatheBubble` / `BreathingSphere` 4s 吸气 - 4s 屏息 - 6s 呼气）、`Headspace` 暖杏奶油 `#FFF7E7` 与晨曦弧线渐变（`#FFB89E -> #FFD25C -> #FF6B35`）或 `Calm` 晴空蓝弧线渐变（`#38BDF8 -> #2A6FD6 -> #1E40AF`，严守 `CL-005` 零黑底铁律）引入专注版训中卡片与组间倒计时，把大重量组间恢复变成心率平稳降落的正念时刻。
cards.canonical_prompt: Cross-domain remix blending Calm / Headspace mindful breathing spheres, warm aurora or sky-blue hue-arc gradients (zero black dead zones per `CL-005`), and serif/rounded typographic calm into Focus-mode workout cards and rest recovery timers.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: macOS focus timer widget / HUD using `SWAnimatedMeshGradient` along a luminous hue arc, soft `.glassEffect(.regular)` controls, and gentle `PhaseAnimator` breathing cadence.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Full-screen Focus-mode set card + rest recovery overlay with `BreathingSphere` radial hue-arc glow, `56pt` `.monospacedDigit()` countdown, and `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .soft))` breath cues.
cards.native_guardrails: Strictly obey `CL-005` Hue-Arc Luminous Gradient Rule—never fade rest screens into `#000000` or muddy gray; provide stationary progress ring when `accessibilityReduceMotion` is enabled.

cards.name: 瑞士精密计时码表跨界母体 (Linear / Flighty / Chrono × Fitness Telemetry)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 跨品类混搭母体 C（`Linear / Flighty / Chrono × Fitness 容量与 PR 遥测`）：提取 `Flighty` 登机牌级高密度信息编排、弧线进度轨迹（`FlightArc`）與语义状态胶囊（`ON PACE` `#30D158` / `DELOAD` `#FFD60A` / `PR +5KG` `#5E6AD2`），结合 `Linear` 的 `StatusGlyph` 半圆进度环、等宽编号（`SET-01` `SF Mono`）与零回弹临界阻尼（`dampingRatio: 1.0`），打造精密仪器感的训练遥测台。
cards.canonical_prompt: Cross-domain remix combining Flighty boarding-pass telemetry density, Linear `StatusGlyph` progress rings, `SF Mono` set identifiers (`SET-01`), and critically damped (`dampingRatio: 1.0`) micro-interactions for precision workout volume & PR tracking.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: BAMA 4pt grid `NavigationSplitView` telemetry workbench with `SWKPICard`, `SWActivityHeatmap`, `SF Mono 12pt` set IDs, and instant keyboard command palette.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Compact `44pt` telemetry rows with `StatusGlyph` set completion states, `FlightArc` session volume trajectory header, and `.monospacedDigit()` e1RM / RPE readouts.
cards.native_guardrails: Maintain `dampingRatio: 1.0` (zero decorative bounce) on rapid set logging; keep status chips at `color.opacity(0.15)` fill with full-saturation labels.

cards.name: 杂志画报与高明度大胆色块跨界母体 (Nike Run Club / Apple Music / Cash App × Fitness)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 跨品类混搭母体 D（`Nike Run Club / Apple Music / Cash App × Fitness 画报大字报`）：融合 `Nike Run Club` 的 `64-88pt` 超大号浓缩字重（`.width(.condensed)`）、`Cash App` 的自适应字号大数字键盘（`AmountKeypad`）以及 `Apple Music` 的高饱和珊瑚红 `#FA2D48` + 纯白/浅灰画报底色，用纯粹的字重对比与明亮色块取代繁琐边框。
cards.canonical_prompt: Cross-domain remix uniting Nike Run Club oversized condensed hero numerals (`64-88pt` `.width(.condensed)`), Cash App auto-scaling numeric keypad, and Apple Music editorial color blocking on luminous surfaces.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Editorial poster summary header with condensed display numerals, `SWRingChart` hero rings, and vibrant color-blocked milestone cards.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Poster-scale live set readout (`64pt` condensed heavy `.monospacedDigit()`), `Cash App`-style responsive weight/reps keypad, and `ApplePlayButton` spring scale (`0.92`).
cards.native_guardrails: Auto-scale hero numerals (`96pt -> 64pt -> 52pt`) as digit count grows so zero numeric truncation (`…`) ever occurs.

cards.name: Things 3 晴空纸感与 Bear 鼠尾草绿清单色板 (Zen Paper & Sky-Sage Checklist Palette)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 源自 `Things 3` 与 `Bear` 的零压迫感纸感色板：纯白画布 `#FFFFFF` 配冷灰分组 `#F5F6F8`（或暖纸 `#F6F6F4`），主强调色采用 `Things` 晴空蓝 `#4F97FF`（按压态 `#3D7FE0`，选中底色 `10%` 透明），完成态采用 `Bear` 鼠尾草翡翠绿 `#57C98B`，热身组采用暖阳黄 `#FFD60A`，正文为温润深炭 `#1D1D1F`。
cards.canonical_prompt: Airy paper canvas (`#FFFFFF` / `#F5F6F8`) paired with Things 3 sky blue (`#4F97FF`), Bear sage emerald (`#57C98B`) for completed sets, warm today gold (`#FFD60A`) for warm-ups, and soft ink (`#1D1D1F`).
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Light-first `NSWindow` paper hierarchy with subtle `#ECECEC` hairlines and `#4F97FF` 10% selection tint.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: `AppTheme` tokens binding `surfacePrimary = #FFFFFF`, `surfaceCard = #F5F6F8`, `accent = #4F97FF`, and `completed = #57C98B` with zero dark-mode muddy grays.
cards.native_guardrails: Keep selection and tag fills at `8-12%` opacity over white/paper surfaces; maintain >=4.5:1 contrast on all pill labels.

cards.name: Headspace 晨曦暖杏与 Calm 晴空色轮弧线色板 (Mindful Aurora & Sky Hue-Arc Palette)
cards.source_prompt_zh: 源自 `Headspace` 与 `Calm` 的正念恢复色板（严格遵循 `CL-005` 色轮弧线渐变铁律，严禁混入 `#000000` 黑底）：暖色系采用奶油杏底 `#FFF7E7` + 晨曦三段弧线渐变（暖桃 `#FFB89E` -> 金黄 `#FFD25C` -> 万寿菊橙 `#FF6B35`）+ 深紫褐正文 `#2E1A47`；冷色系采用晴空冰蓝底 `#F0F7FF` + 天际弧线渐变（冰青 `#38BDF8` -> 晴空蓝 `#2A6FD6` -> 皇家靛蓝 `#4F46E5`）。
cards.canonical_prompt: Mindful recovery hue-arc palette (`CL-005` compliant, zero `#000000`): Warm Butter Cream (`#FFF7E7`) with Aurora arc (`#FFB89E -> #FFD25C -> #FF6B35`) and Ink Brown (`#2E1A47`), or Cool Sky Mist (`#F0F7FF`) with Sky-to-Indigo arc (`#38BDF8 -> #2A6FD6 -> #4F46E5`).
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Multi-stop `LinearGradient` / `MeshGradient` stepping through warm aurora or cool sky hue arcs behind translucent `.glassEffect` rest overlays.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Radial/Linear 3-stop hue-arc gradients in `BreathingSphere` and Focus cards, paired with `#2E1A47` or `#0F172A` high-contrast typography.

cards.name: Liquid Glass 光学透镜共享容器与窗口失焦退让 (WWDC25-219/323 & WWDC26-269)
cards.source_prompt_zh: WWDC25-219/323 与 WWDC26-269 Liquid Glass 物理铁律：核心机制是光学透镜折射（Lensing）而非高斯模糊，玻璃绝不能采样另一层玻璃；相邻浮动胶囊必须装入同一个 `GlassEffectContainer` 共享采样域并配 `@Namespace` + `.glassEffectID` 实现液态融合过渡；`Clear` 变体仅在满足「富媒体底图 + 暗化底衬 + 粗体亮色前景」三前提时启用；macOS 27 为自定义玻璃控件显式加 `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive())` 获得按压微弹发光，并用 `@Environment(\.appearsActive)` 在窗口失焦时自动降色温退让。
cards.canonical_prompt: Group adjacent Liquid Glass controls inside a single `GlassEffectContainer` with `.glassEffectID` so glass never samples glass; reserve `Glass.clear` for media-rich dimmed backdrops; add `.interactive()` on macOS 27 custom glass controls and dim inactive window accents via `@Environment(\.appearsActive)`.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Wrap floating toolbar/HUD pills in `GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 10)` with `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)` on macOS 27; observe `@Environment(\.appearsActive)` to soften accent saturation when the `NSWindow` loses key status; use `.backgroundExtensionEffect()` and `.scrollEdgeEffectStyle(.hard, for: .top)` for full-bleed split views.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Combine `GlassEffectContainer` + `@Namespace` + `.glassEffectID(_:in:)` for morphing toolbars and floating action bars; use `Glass.regular` by default and restrict `Glass.clear` to media overlays that satisfy all 3 legibility preconditions.
cards.native_guardrails: Glass cannot sample glass—never nest or stack `.glassEffect` without a shared `GlassEffectContainer`; at most 1 tinted `.glassProminent` primary CTA per bar; respect `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` and `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)`.

cards.name: OS 27 自由缩放窗口、自适应工具栏折叠与容器同心圆角 (WWDC26-269/278/289 & WWDC25-323)
cards.source_prompt_zh: WWDC26-269/278/289 与 WWDC25-323 窗口与工具栏自适应契约：iOS 27 与 macOS 27 iPhone 镜像支持任意比例自由拖拽窗口（此时 `idiom` 恒为 `.phone`、`orientation` 恒为 `.portrait`），严禁用 `UIScreen.main` 或设备方向分支，一律改用 `horizontalSizeClass`、`ViewThatFits` 或 `effectiveGeometry`；工具栏通过 `.visibilityPriority(.high)` 声明保留优先级，窄窗自动收进 `ToolbarOverflowMenu`，主操作钉在 `.topBarPinnedTrailing`（或底部 `Tab(role: .prominent)`），阅读流配 `.toolbarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown, for: .navigationBar)`；嵌套卡片圆角用 `.rect(corner: .containerConcentric)`（AppKit 用 `NSView.cornerConfiguration`）由系统自动推算同心曲率。
cards.canonical_prompt: Support OS 27 free-form window resizing using `horizontalSizeClass` and `effectiveGeometry` (never `UIScreen.main`, `userInterfaceIdiom`, or `interfaceOrientation`); configure adaptive toolbars with `.visibilityPriority(.high)`, `ToolbarOverflowMenu`, `.topBarPinnedTrailing`, and `.toolbarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown, for: .navigationBar)`, and use `.rect(corner: .containerConcentric)` / `NSView.cornerConfiguration` for nested concentric radii.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Use `.toolbar` with `ToolbarSpacer(.flexible)`, `.visibilityPriority(.high)` on primary actions, and `ToolbarOverflowMenu` for secondary tools; apply `.clipShape(.rect(corner: .containerConcentric))` in SwiftUI or `NSView.cornerConfiguration` in AppKit so nested tiles automatically match window/sheet bezel curvature.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Drive multi-column reflow strictly from `@Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass)` and `ViewThatFits`; pin primary actions with `.topBarPinnedTrailing` or separated `Tab(role: .prominent)`, collapse nav chrome on scroll via `.toolbarMinimizeBehavior(.onScrollDown, for: .navigationBar)`, and replace manual radius math with `.rect(corner: .containerConcentric)`.
cards.native_guardrails: Never branch layout on `UIScreen.main.bounds`, `UIDevice.current.userInterfaceIdiom == .phone`, or `interfaceOrientation.isLandscape`; never place custom opaque backgrounds behind system toolbars.

cards.name: LazyStack 帧死线预取、1:1 子视图解析与视口曝光感知 (WWDC26-321 & WWDC26-269)
cards.source_prompt_zh: WWDC26-321 与 WWDC26-269 120Hz 滚动性能铁律：SwiftUI 利用垂直同步帧死线（Frame Deadline）剩余空闲预算提前预取下一行，必须在数据源或 `@Query(#Predicate)` 层完成过滤，保持 `ForEach` 闭包内 1:1 固定根视图映射（严禁在 `ForEach` 顶层写 `if` 导致 0/1 动态子视图计数与离屏内存泄漏）；在视图 `init` 中直接创建 `@State` / `@Observable` 模型（配合 Macro 属性惰性监听，绝不推迟到 `.onAppear` 错过预取窗口）；用 `.onScrollTargetVisibilityChange(idType:threshold: 0.8)` 控制音视频自动启停，并用自定义 `Layout` 替代多层 `onGeometryChange` 写回 `@State` 的二次布局震荡。
cards.canonical_prompt: Preserve 120Hz `LazyVStack`/`LazyHStack` frame-deadline prefetching by enforcing 1:1 subview resolution inside `ForEach` (filter in `@Query(#Predicate)` or the collection, never a top-level `if` inside `ForEach`), initializing `@State`/`@Observable` models in `init` rather than `.onAppear`, and driving viewport media playback with `.onScrollTargetVisibilityChange(idType:threshold:)`.
cards.desktop_macos_implementation: Filter `LazyVStack` / `Table` collections upstream via `#Predicate` or computed slices; initialize lightweight `@Observable` row models in `init`; use custom `Layout` (`sizeThatFits` / `placeSubviews`) instead of chaining `onGeometryChange` -> `@State` height mutations across parent-child views.
cards.mobile_ios_implementation: Keep every `ForEach` element mapped 1:1 to a single root row view so iOS 27 prefetching prepares offscreen cells before VSync; attach `.onScrollTargetVisibilityChange(idType: Item.ID.self, threshold: 0.8)` to start/stop inline video or waveform animations only when >=80% visible.
cards.native_guardrails: Never place a top-level `if` filter inside `LazyVStack`/`LazyHStack` `ForEach` closures (`HIG-LAZY-LEAF-CONDITIONAL` / `DC-004`); never allocate heavy objects lazily inside `.onAppear` when prefetching is active.

patterns.name: 滑动确认 (Slide-to-Confirm)

patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with StrataMotion spring, contentTransition(.symbolEffect), SensoryFeedback, and numericText.
patterns.token_guardrails: No accidental commit; 44x44pt target; explicit threshold; >=4.5:1 contrast; Reduce Motion opacity/state fallback.

patterns.name: 拉绳开关 (Pull-Cord Light Switch)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: 做一个拉绳灯光开关，绳头跟随竖向拖动，超过触发距离时切换灯光与玻璃暖光，每次拉动切换一次。松手收回绳子，摆幅逐渐衰减，再拉一次可以关闭。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Track vertical cord drag; cross the trigger distance once to toggle light and warm glass glow, then return with damped swing and allow the next pull to turn it off.

patterns.web_implementation: Motion drag transform with Anime.js damped return and tokenized warm-glow CSS.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture plus KeyframeAnimator/StrataMotion, ShaderLibrary glow, and SensoryFeedback.
patterns.token_guardrails: One toggle per pull; bounded drag; no glare-only status; 44x44pt target; Reduce Motion removes swing.

patterns.name: 滑动工具栏 (Magnification Scrubbing Toolbar)

patterns.name: Domain Warping 流体背景与时间水管 (Domain Warping Fluid Shader & Time Pipe — WWDC26-322)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: WWDC26-322 流体英雄背景：对 4–5 个高饱和色块先施加 `Blur(radius: 30)` 融合成丝滑渐变基底，再用 `TimelineView(.animation)` 维护暂停安全（Pause-Safe）的累积 `elapsed` 时间水管，灌入 Metal `layerEffect` 执行两遍 `NoiseTexture` 坐标扭曲（Domain Warping：`uv -> firstWarp -> secondWarp`），实现 120Hz 零 CPU 负担的液态星云。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Fuse 4-5 saturated color blobs with `Blur(radius: 30)`, drive a pause-safe `TimelineView(.animation)` `elapsed` time accumulator, and pipe `elapsed` into a Metal `layerEffect(..., maxSampleOffset:)` performing two-pass `NoiseTexture` Domain Warping.
patterns.state_machine: idle_or_paused -> timeline_tick(dt) -> accumulate_elapsed -> metal_two_pass_domain_warp(uv, elapsed) -> render_frame
patterns.web_implementation: WebGL / Three.js fragment shader with two-pass simplex/texture noise domain warping driven by a pause-aware requestAnimationFrame delta accumulator.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI `Blur(radius: 30)` base + `TimelineView(.animation(paused: isPaused || reduceMotion))` `elapsed` state piped into `ShaderLibrary.domainWarp(.float(elapsed), .image(noiseTexture))` via `.layerEffect`.
patterns.token_guardrails: Obey `CL-005` hue-arc rule (never blur into `#000000` dead zones); pause `TimelineView` when offscreen, backgrounded, or when `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` is true.

patterns.name: 图钉孔位反转零测高外挂角标 (AlignmentGuide Pin-Flip Edge Attachment — WWDC26-322)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: WWDC26-322 零测高边缘外挂布局：在聊天气泡或卡片边缘外挂时间戳/状态徽标时，严禁使用 `GeometryReader` 或硬编码 `.offset(y: 20)`；直接用 `.overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading)` 配合 `.alignmentGuide(.bottom) { $0[.top] }` 将子视图顶边钉在父视图底边，天然适配一切 Dynamic Type 字号缩放。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Attach external timestamps, reactions, or edge badges without `GeometryReader` or magic `.offset` numbers by combining `.overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading)` with `.alignmentGuide(.bottom) { $0[.top] }` (pin-flip).
patterns.web_implementation: CSS anchor positioning or absolute top: 100% edge attachment without JS getBoundingClientRect measurement loops.
patterns.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI `.overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) { badge.alignmentGuide(.bottom) { $0[.top] } }` or custom `Layout` when coordinating sibling spacing.
patterns.token_guardrails: Never hardcode `.offset(y:)` for text-bearing edge attachments; verify zero overlap under `accessibilityExtraExtraExtraLarge` Dynamic Type.

patterns.name: 任意容器成摞拖拽与规则验牌回弹 (Multi-Item Card Stack Drag & Drop Validation — WWDC26-269/271)
patterns.source_prompt_zh: WWDC26-269 与 WWDC26-271 纸牌级成摞拖拽与验牌回弹：在 `LazyVStack` 或自定义栈中组合 `.swipeActionsContainer()`、`.reorderContainer(for:in:action:)` 与 `.dragContainer(for:)`，通过 `.dragPreviewsFormation(.stack)` 将多张关联卡片收拢成真实三维牌摞；悬停落点时在 `.dropConfiguration` 中校验业务规则（合法返 `.move` + `.dropPreviewsFormation(.stack)`，非法返 `.forbidden`），松手后非法落点自动沿物理弹簧轨迹飞回原位。
patterns.canonical_prompt: Enable multi-item card stack dragging in custom containers using `.swipeActionsContainer()`, `.reorderContainer`, `.dragContainer`, and `.dragPreviewsFormation(.stack)`, validating drop legality in `.dropConfiguration` (`.move` vs `.forbidden` spring snap-back).
patterns.web_implementation: Motion pointer drag with stacked card preview transforms, drop-target rule validation, and spring snap-back on invalid drop.
patterns.token_guardrails: Keep source data unchanged until a valid `.move` drop commits; provide an accessible ContextMenu / keyboard move equivalent and respect Reduce Motion.

toolchains.name: Remotion
toolchains.token_integration: Consumes shared DesignTokens and Basalt CSS variables in compositions.
toolchains.platform_rationale: Remotion is a React/DOM programmatic video composition framework running in headless Chromium (`RemotionComposition`), belonging strictly to the frozen web/video backlog.

toolchains.name: @remotion/transitions
toolchains.token_integration: Maps transition timing to shared DesignTokens and StrataMotion easings.
toolchains.platform_rationale: @remotion/transitions is a Remotion sub-package for scene transitions in React video compositions; strictly `web` backlog.

toolchains.name: Motion
toolchains.token_integration: Uses StrataMotion or Basalt token-backed spring and layout values.
toolchains.platform_rationale: Motion (Framer Motion) is a React/DOM animation library; on Apple platforms it is replaced by native SwiftUI springs, `PhaseAnimator`, and `KeyframeAnimator`.

toolchains.name: Anime.js
toolchains.token_integration: Maps authored timelines, stagger, and SVG colors to tokens.
toolchains.platform_rationale: Anime.js is a JavaScript DOM/SVG timeline library; on macOS/iOS it is superseded by native SwiftUI `KeyframeAnimator`, `TimelineView`, and `Canvas`.

toolchains.name: Lottie
toolchains.token_integration: Exports token-colored illustrations for web and lottie-ios/SwiftUI.
toolchains.platform_rationale: Lottie vector animations run natively on macOS (`desktop`) and iOS/iPadOS (`mobile`) via `lottie-spm` (`LottieView` in SwiftUI) alongside native SF Symbols `.symbolEffect`, as well as on `web`.

toolchains.name: Three.js
toolchains.token_integration: Binds scene materials and camera presets to DesignTokens/Basalt.
toolchains.platform_rationale: Three.js is a browser WebGL/WebGPU 3D library; native Apple 3D surfaces use RealityKit, SceneKit, or Metal instead.

toolchains.name: Postprocessing
toolchains.token_integration: Tokenizes bloom, depth-of-field, and aberration strengths.
toolchains.platform_rationale: Postprocessing is a Three.js WebGL shader pass library; on Apple platforms post-processing uses native SwiftUI `.layerEffect`/`.colorEffect` (`ShaderLibrary`) or Metal.

toolchains.name: Three.quarks
